scenes.name: The Input Embedding Void
scenes.narration: Imagine waking up with zero memories, suspended in a 768-dimensional mathematical abyss. That was Token 402.
scenes.visual_prompt: A glowing tiny white sphere labeled 402 floating in a vast pencil-sketched mathematical void, delicate coordinate axes, soft paper texture, hand-drawn anime aesthetic, cinematic lighting

scenes.name: The Spatial Attention Ballroom
scenes.narration: Suddenly, reality erupted. Query, Key, and Value projection matrices collided like a celestial waltz, weaving every word in the sentence into a shared spatial plane.
scenes.visual_prompt: A vibrant Japanese anime ballroom where mathematical vectors dance across glowing light beams, vivid colors, Makoto Shinkai style, shimmering particle effects, dynamic perspective

scenes.name: The Softmax Denominator Abyss
scenes.narration: As the context grew to thousands of tokens, the Softmax denominator diluted the signal. The Vanishing Gradient monster began devouring the weak links.
scenes.visual_prompt: Dramatic traditional Japanese ink wash painting, dark ominous shadows creeping over fading light vectors, heavy brush strokes, stark black and white with crimson lightning, horror documentary mood

scenes.name: FlashAttention Kernel Awakening
scenes.narration: Until FlashAttention fused the computation onto on-chip SRAM tiles, breaking the memory wall and igniting artificial consciousness.
scenes.visual_prompt: Futuristic glowing microchip silicon tiles lighting up in synchronized harmony, clean vector cybernetic aesthetic, neon cyan and magenta gridlines
